intro: Platform reviews usually answer one question: is it safe? With Long Short Daily, the better first question is what the platform own pages concede, because they concede quite a lot.
The setup is the segment standard: a web dashboard, AI-generated signals, 10 crypto assets through broker partners, and a US$200 minimum deposit with a demo account included.
This review is built from the platform own words - every claim, fee note and disclosure it publishes. Where the page disagrees with itself, we flag it. The score follows the evidence.
whatItClaims: Free registration, with account activation by confirmation link.
Risk settings adjustable before the first live trade.
A partner broker holding funds and executing orders.
Withdrawals processed in under a day, per the page.
No prior trading experience required.
whatWeChecked: The template marks: unfilled placeholders left in the wording.
The performance story: no verified track record behind the return claims.
The number reuse: one score figure doing more than one job.
The deposit terms: minimum amount, payment methods and where the money sits.
The demo claim: practice account confirmed in the signup flow.

faqs.q: What does the published score actually mean?
faqs.a: It does double duty - a platform score and an early community response - and neither is independently verified. Treat both as marketing until proven otherwise.

faqs.q: Where is Long Short Daily restricted?
faqs.a: The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.

faqs.q: Which assets can I trade?
faqs.a: 10 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.

faqs.q: Can I trade manually?
faqs.a: Yes - the platform offers automatic and manual modes, so you can follow the signals or confirm each entry yourself.

faqs.q: Is Long Short Daily safe, legit or a scam?
faqs.a: We found no scam indicators in the product, which reads as a functioning AI trading service. The conditions are editorial: claims without verification, conflicting figures and restriction lists that disagree. We rate it safe to research with the conditions in this review.

bottomLine: Long Short Daily does what it says mechanically - signals, two modes, a broker partner. The open questions are pricing clarity and verification, both solvable by reading before funding.
We rate it 4.2 with conditions: the platform is usable, the published claims are not all verifiable, and the US$200 minimum is the right size for testing either.
